responsibility: Implements rs6000 function prologue, epilogue, frame-layout, and shrink-wrapping support. It computes which registers and special state must be saved, builds stack frame layout information, emits ABI-specific save/restore and TOC setup code, supports split-stack entry checks, traceback/unwind metadata, and separate prologue/epilogue components, making it the backend source that owns PowerPC stack-frame construction and entry/exit code generation.
